------
Nikhil Jaiswal @ Nikhil Kumar Jaiswal ... Petitioner Versus The State of Jharkhand & Anr. ...
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY ------

For the Petitioner : Mr. Naveen Kr. Jaiswal, Advocate For the State : Mrs. Ruby Pandey, Addl. P.P.
For O.P. No.2 : Mr. Suvendra Jaipuriar, Advocate ------
Order No.08 Dated- 19.09.2023 Heard the parties.

Apprehending his arrest, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Complaint Case No.10067 of 2021 registered under sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 3/4 of D.P. Act.

The Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner being the husband of the complainant has treated the complainant with cruelty in connection with demand of dowry.
It is further submitted that the allegations against the petitioner are all false.
It is jointly submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 that they have compromised but the final settlement will be over by 10.10.2023.
It is then submitted that the petitioner undertakes to cooperate with the trial of the case.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned Addl. P.P. opposes the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail.
Considering the submissions of the counsels and the fact as discussed above, I am inclined to grant privileges of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in Nikhil Jaiswal @ Nikhil Kumar Jaiswal vs The State Of Jharkhand & Anr. ... ...
